45: You must not have any other gods. Included in this prohibition is the popular idolatry of wealth. Many people dedicate themselves to amassing riches, viewing them as if they were powerful gods, in whose name they set aside the true Hashem and His Torah. Yet implicit in the declaration, “I am Ad-noy your God,” is the assurance that if they would only be faithful to Him He would take care of all their needs as a husband looks after his wife.
